name: Open the newest case replay from the front page (signed in, v2)
description: Validates the front page (its heading, the live recorder section, the list of cases) and that the first case in the list opens that case's replay console with its 3D view drawn.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Assert the page heading (h1) reads "Every cable cut, replayed."

Assert the live section (data-testid recorder-status) is shown with a data-state of recording, failing, stale, never-ran or unreachable; unless it is unreachable, its ship count (data-testid recorder-ships) is a whole number
Assert the case list (data-testid landing-cases) holds 10 cases, each a link whose data-testid starts with case-card-
Note the slug in the data-testid of the first case link in that list (case-card-<slug>), then click that link

Assert the URL path is /cases/<slug> for the noted slug, the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown, and the case switcher button (data-testid case-switcher) shows the case's title (not empty)
Then wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert no card saying "The 3D view did not load" is shown
